paper_id: Emoji-Powered Representation Learning for Cross-Lingual Sentiment Classification (Extended Abstract)
title: Emoji-Powered Representation Learning for Cross-Lingual Sentiment Classification (Extended Abstract)
motivation: 非英语用户(74.8%)获得的情感分析服务质量不平等,根源是标注数据英语远超其他语言
problem_framing: 跨语言情感分类:从英语迁移到目标语言,但机器翻译丢失语言特有的情感表达(language discrepancy problem)
key_insight: 表情符号既是情感标签的代理又是语言间桥梁,可同时捕获跨语言通用情感和语言特有情感模式
method_signature: ELSA:用表情符号预测作为监督学习语言特有情感表示,结合翻译后的双语表示做情感分类
evaluation_criteria: Amazon评论数据集准确率(3目标语言×3领域=9任务)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 无法获取基线方法的单个预测,无法报告McNemar检验的统计显著性
evidence_for_taste: machine translation does not tackle well
fails to capture sentiment knowledge specific to the target language
not dominated by the source language
incorporating language-specific knowledge for both languages is critical
thinking_moves: 诊断现有MT方法失败根因:追求跨语言泛化时丢失语言特有情感知识
寻找全球通用的情感表达信号作为翻译的补充桥梁
用表情符号预测作为远程监督学习语言特有表示,避免显式标注
通过消融实验验证双向语言特有表示的必要性
extraction_notes: extended abstract of WWW 2019 paper; full method and evaluation details available; IJCAI 2020 venue confirms top-tier status
